facts.fact: The NCFI Annual Financial Inclusion Report 2025, as reported, says the NIDA database is connected with 138 public and private institutions, improving e-KYC processes for banks, insurance companies and social security institutions.
The report names banks, insurance companies and social security institutions as using NIDA-connected e-KYC processes.
The report counts 138 public and private institutions connected to the NIDA database.
